Overview

Los Angeles is a city in CA with a population of 3,822,238. Entertainment capital with perfect weather, beaches, and a diverse economy — but housing costs are extreme. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 10b growing zone supports Hot — tropical and subtropical crops, year-round growing. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 284 sunny days a year.
